title: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR)
item_service_description:
<p><strong>A.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;General</strong></p>
<p>Transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR - also known as TAVI or transcatheter aortic valve implantation) is used in the treatment of aortic stenosis (AS). A bioprosthetic valve is inserted percutaneously using a catheter and implanted in the orifice of the aortic valve.</p>
